title: biomes.field/1
description: data/biomes/field.json: planet generation 3's ground, a field of nodes on a cube-sphere (docs/world/ring-any-angle/research.md T6 stage 3; WorldField). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore.

cells.description: Cells along a face's edge: the canonical lattice (38,400 / cells units a cell). A multiple of bakeStride.

bakeStride.description: The bake is every bakeStride-th node of the canonical lattice.

enabled.description: Off, a gen 3 place is laid from the chord as gen 2's is.

yawSteps.description: A place's street axis is one of this many yaws in a half turn, keyed by the planet and the place.

align.description: Turn a place's plan to the ring it is first laid on, so its street runs along the line and a band lies on the lanes (as dense as the chord layout). Off, the street's yaw is keyed by the planet and the place.

bandsCity.description: A city's plan is the street's strip laid this many times each side of the middle one, a lane-band (pitchBH) apart, so a ring at any bearing crosses several.

pitchBH.description: The distance between bands, in fighter heights (the depth of the fight lanes' band, 32).

minBuildings.description: A place that would stand fewer buildings than this on a ring falls back to the chord layout.

sub.description: A refined cell is read at this many times the resolution (4: 32 units, a ring column).

step.description: A cell whose corners differ by more than this many units is refined (a wall, a cliff).

shoreBand.description: A cell whose corner heights span the shoreline height (WorldWater.SHORE_WET), widened by this many units each side, is refined.
